Header.value: Select entity type (click existing annotation to delete, or drag-select text to add)

Text.name: def1
Text.value: AISystem: Named AI system, product, or platform (e.g. ChatGPT, Tesla Autopilot). AIModel: Named AI/ML model (e.g. GPT-4, BERT). AITechnique: AI method or technique (e.g. deep learning, NLP). AICapability: AI system capability (e.g. text generation, image recognition).

Text.name: def2
Text.value: Stakeholder: Organization, company, institution, or individual mentioned in the document. Role badges (from LLM inference, for reference): AIDeveloper = develops/trains AI systems AIProvider = provides/distributes AI systems AIDeployer = deploys AI in business AIUser = directly uses AI Regulator = government body that regulates/investigates AI AffectedActor = individual or group harmed by AI risks

Text.name: def3
Text.value: Regulation: Named law or regulation (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR). Standard: Technical or industry standard (e.g. ISO 42001).

Text.name: guide
Text.value:
Steps: 1. Left side shows the document with pre-extracted entities (colored highlights) 2. Confirm pre-annotations: keep correct ones, delete incorrect ones 3. For missed entities: select entity type on the right, then drag-select text on the left
Rules: - Only annotate entities explicitly mentioned in the text - Dragged text becomes the mention_span - High recall preferred: annotate when in doubt - Each entity must have the correct type
Entity types: - AISystem/Model/Technique/Capability: named AI products, models, methods, or capabilities - Stakeholder: organizations or individuals (with sub-roles: AIDeveloper/Provider/Deployer/User/Regulator/AffectedActor) - Regulation/Standard: named laws or industry standards
